review_notes: I read the whole file. It has only four new definitions: gradientEnergyConstant, gradientNormPath, gradientIntegral and gradientH3Bound. Each one is a numeric constant or a project-specific object. gradientNormPath is built from the repo's own finiteField and Evolution. gradientIntegral is a thin named wrapper around the repo's realIntegral. None of them re-implements a Mathlib structure or class. The remaining declarations are theorems. A possible overlap is norm_le_sum_coordinates, which resembles a general norm-versus-coordinate-sum bound. That is standalone theorem duplication, which the rubric excludes, so I did not report it. I did not read the repo's own realIntegral or Evolution definitions in detail. I found no clear competing Mathlib concept, so I abstained.
